label: Analytics tag missing from the live site
detail: The GA4 tracking code was not on the live site from 2026-02-25 until it was restored on 2026-08-07. Sessions and pageviews read zero across that span. Those zeros are missing measurement, not lost traffic.

label: Analytics restored; follower tracking begins
detail: GA4 tracking fixed. Bluesky, Instagram and Facebook follower counts recorded for the first time — none of these networks publish history, so the series starts here and grows forward.
